name: Stay Humble
definition: We stay open-minded, grounded, and grateful for our successes, always looking for ways to improve and evolve.

rows.under: Concludes the strategy is proven, and stops examining it.
rows.justRight: Asks how much was the plan and how much was luck, and keeps looking for the next improvement.
rows.over: Discounts the win so thoroughly that the team never gets to feel that it worked.

rows.situation: When someone tells you that you are wrong
rows.under: Defends the position because it is yours.
rows.justRight: Assumes there is something in it, finds that part, and changes your mind out loud when it is warranted.
rows.over: Concedes to whoever spoke last, and the team cannot rely on your position.

rows.situation: When your title would get you the answer
rows.under: Uses the title. People comply, and stop telling you things.
rows.justRight: Earns the answer through the argument, and treats the title as irrelevant to whether you are right.
rows.over: Refuses to use your authority even when a decision genuinely needs it.

rows.situation: When a smaller competitor does something better
rows.under: Explains why their situation does not apply to you.
rows.justRight: Goes and learns how they did it, and takes what transfers.
rows.over: Copies a competitor's move without asking whether their conditions are yours.

rows.situation: When the outcome is being attributed
rows.under: Accepts the credit for work other people did.
rows.justRight: Names who did what, and says plainly which parts were outside anyone's control.
rows.over: Deflects credit so hard that your own contribution becomes invisible and unmanageable.
